reviews.title: Item describe as with Lighting Node Core, but it was not include
reviews.comment: Description says "2-Pack with Lighting Node CORE" but there were only 2-fans. I half expected this due to the price is about half that listed on the Corsair WEB page, but still, the description should not list the Lighting Node CORE as included when it is not. If it really is to be included, then I would like the Lighting Node CORE to be sent. :-\
reviews.author: datwho75

reviews.title: RGB Defective
reviews.comment: Fans were low noise, and felt solid. RGB lights did not work on either one, granted they were used, but like new they were not. Installed in a Corsair case already set with RGB controller, did not work. Used RGB controller supplied with fans, no luck either. Used current RGB lights with new RGB controller,  they worked. This took most of the evening to do. Return process wasn't bad but still waiting on refund.
reviews.author: John F
